notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}
When Cult Conscript dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
